reason: My wheels are fine and I'm on a tight budget, so I'm not buying a set this month. If I ever did want wheels I'd hunt Marketplace and eBay, where I can find decent used sets for well under £240 and I know how to spot a bend or crack myself.
objection: £240 is more than I'd pay on Marketplace for a used set I can check myself, and a new seller with no reviews means I'd be taking their word that the refinishing isn't hiding anything.
would_change_my_mind: A set that fits my car at around £160-180, plus a few reviews or photos of past sets I could judge for myself.
